### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of the megatest results: one subdirectory per --aligner route (aligner_cellranger/ required; aligner_simpleaf/, aligner_kallisto/ optional, feed the Aligner concordance tab) plus aligner_cellranger/multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet. |
| `MARKER_PANEL` | — | Optional comma-separated gene symbols the per-cell marker tiles (Markers violin, gene UMAP Colour by menu) always carry, e.g. the lineage markers of the tissue. Unset, or with none of its genes in the reference, the tiles use the top markers of every graph-based cluster instead. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`cellbender/metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellbender/metrics.py) | CellBender's per-sample ambient-RNA removal metrics, pivoted to one row per sample. | `sample`, `total_raw_counts`, `total_output_counts`, `total_counts_removed`, `fraction_counts_removed`, `expected_cells`, `found_cells`, `ratio_of_found_cells_to_expected_cells`, `target_fpr` |
| [`cellranger/aligner_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/aligner_summary.py) | One row per `--aligner` route, the headline numbers a reader compares them on. | `aligner`, `cells_called`, `cellbender_cells`, `median_umi_per_cell`, `mapping_rate` |
| [`cellranger/barcode_rank.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/barcode_rank.py) | Barcode-rank ("knee") curve from the raw feature-barcode matrix. | `sample`, `rank`, `umi_count`, `is_cell` |
| [`cellranger/cell_calls_by_method.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cell_calls_by_method.py) | One row per barcode called a cell by ANY method, across all three aligner routes. | `barcode_core`, `cellranger`, `cellranger_cellbender`, `simpleaf_cellbender`, `kallisto`, `kallisto_cellbender`, `n_callers` |
| [`cellranger/cell_cycle.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cell_cycle.py) | Cell-cycle phase per cell, from the Tirosh S and G2/M gene sets. | `sample`, `barcode`, `cluster_label`, `s_score`, `g2m_score`, `phase`, `n_s_genes`, `n_g2m_genes` |
| [`cellranger/cell_expression.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cell_expression.py) | One row per called cell, one column per panel gene: the table that turns the | `sample`, `barcode`, `cluster_label`, `qc_status`, `umap_1`, `umap_2` |
| [`cellranger/cell_expression_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cell_expression_long.py) | A marker-panel slice of `cellranger_cell_expression`, melted: one row per | `sample`, `barcode`, `cluster_label`, `qc_status`, `gene`, `expression` |
| [`cellranger/cell_funnel.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cell_funnel.py) | The filtering waterfall: how many barcodes survive each step, per sample. | `sample`, `barcodes_observed`, `cells_called`, `cellbender_cells`, `cells_qc_pass`, `pct_called`, `pct_qc_pass` |
| [`cellranger/cell_qc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cell_qc.py) | The cell hub: one row per called cell (filtered-matrix barcode), with QC | `sample`, `barcode`, `barcode_core`, `n_umi`, `n_genes`, `pct_mito`, `pct_ribo`, `pct_hb`, `pct_top20`, `log10_n_umi`, `log10_n_genes`, `graphclust`, `cluster_label`, `kmeans_2`, `kmeans_3`, `kmeans_4`, `kmeans_5`, `kmeans_6`, `kmeans_7`, `kmeans_8`, `kmeans_9`, `kmeans_10`, `umap_1`, `umap_2`, `tsne_1`, `tsne_2`, `pc_1`, `pc_2`, `pc_3`, `cellbender_cell`, `mad_low_umi`, `mad_low_genes`, `mad_high_top20`, `mad_high_mito`, `qc_status`, `qc_reason`, `qc_flagged` |
| [`cellranger/cluster_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/cluster_summary.py) | One row per graph-based cluster, summarising `cellranger_cell_qc`. | `sample`, `graphclust`, `cluster_label`, `n_cells`, `pct_cells`, `median_n_umi`, `median_n_genes`, `median_pct_mito`, `pct_flagged`, `pct_cellbender_cell` |
| [`cellranger/diffexp.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/diffexp.py) | Cluster marker genes from Cell Ranger's differential-expression tables. | `sample`, `resolution`, `cluster`, `cluster_label`, `rank_in_cluster`, `gene_id`, `gene`, `mean_counts`, `log2fc`, `adjusted_pvalue` |
| [`cellranger/hvg_dispersion.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/hvg_dispersion.py) | Feature selection, the step between the count matrix and the PCA nobody sees. | `sample`, `gene`, `normalized_dispersion`, `mean_expression`, `detection_rate`, `selection` |
| [`cellranger/library_metrics_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/library_metrics_long.py) | Long, threshold-annotated form of the 5 metrics 10x's QC guidance gives a | `sample`, `metric`, `value`, `unit`, `threshold`, `status` |
| [`cellranger/mapping_breakdown.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/mapping_breakdown.py) | Long region breakdown of Cell Ranger's confidently-mapped-reads accounting, | `sample`, `region`, `fraction` |
| [`cellranger/marker_expression.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/marker_expression.py) | Dot-plot table: mean log-normalised expression and detection rate of the | `cluster_label`, `gene`, `mean_expression`, `frac_expressing` |
| [`cellranger/marker_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/marker_matrix.py) | Wide companion to `cellranger_marker_expression`, for the `complex_heatmap` | `gene` |
| [`cellranger/metrics_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/metrics_summary.py) | Tidy Cell Ranger's per-sample `metrics_summary.csv` into typed columns. | `sample`, `estimated_cells`, `mean_reads_per_cell`, `median_genes_per_cell`, `number_of_reads`, `valid_barcodes_pct`, `sequencing_saturation_pct`, `q30_barcode_pct`, `q30_rna_read_pct`, `q30_umi_pct`, `reads_mapped_confidently_transcriptome_pct`, `reads_mapped_antisense_pct`, `fraction_reads_in_cells_pct`, `total_genes_detected`, `median_umi_counts_per_cell`, `valid_barcodes_frac`, `sequencing_saturation_frac`, `q30_barcode_frac`, `q30_rna_read_frac`, `q30_umi_frac`, `reads_mapped_confidently_transcriptome_frac`, `reads_mapped_antisense_frac`, `fraction_reads_in_cells_frac` |
| [`cellranger/pca_variance.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellranger/pca_variance.py) | Variance explained by each of Cell Ranger's reported PCA components. | `sample`, `pc`, `variance_explained` |
| [`kallisto/run_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/kallisto/run_metrics.py) | kallisto \| bustools (kb count) run headline numbers, one row per sample. | `sample`, `n_processed`, `n_pseudoaligned`, `p_pseudoaligned`, `n_barcodes`, `cells_called` |
| [`nf-core/scrnaseq/kallisto_cellbender_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/scrnaseq/recipes/kallisto_cellbender_metrics.py) | CellBender's per-sample metrics on the kallisto route. | `sample`, `total_raw_counts`, `total_output_counts`, `total_counts_removed`, `fraction_counts_removed`, `expected_cells`, `found_cells`, `ratio_of_found_cells_to_expected_cells`, `target_fpr` |
| [`nf-core/scrnaseq/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/scrnaseq/recipes/samples.py) | One row per scRNA-seq sample, from the samplesheet the pipeline validated. | `sample_id`, `expected_cells`, `n_lanes` |
| [`nf-core/scrnaseq/simpleaf_cellbender_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/scrnaseq/recipes/simpleaf_cellbender_metrics.py) | CellBender's per-sample metrics on the simpleaf route. | `sample`, `total_raw_counts`, `total_output_counts`, `total_counts_removed`, `fraction_counts_removed`, `expected_cells`, `found_cells`, `ratio_of_found_cells_to_expected_cells`, `target_fpr` |
| [`qcatch/metrics_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/qcatch/metrics_summary.py) | Tidy QCatch's per-sample `<sample>_metrics_summary.csv` into typed columns. | `sample`, `retained_cells`, `processed_cells`, `mean_reads_per_retained_cell`, `median_umi_per_retained_cell`, `median_genes_per_retained_cell`, `total_genes_detected`, `mapping_rate_pct`, `sequencing_saturation_pct` |
| [`simpleaf/barcode_rank.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/simpleaf/barcode_rank.py) | Barcode-rank ("knee") curve from simpleaf/alevin-fry's per-barcode feature dump. | `sample`, `aligner`, `rank`, `umi_count`, `is_cell` |
| [`simpleaf/mapping_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/simpleaf/mapping_metrics.py) | simpleaf/alevin-fry mapping headline numbers, one row per sample. | `sample`, `num_processed`, `num_mapped`, `mapping_rate`, `num_cells` |
